description: This is a source file for the 'rich' library's logging handler, providing a custom logging.Handler that formats logs with rich text rendering, including support for traceback visualization and syntax highlighting.

classes.name: RichHandler
classes.description: A custom logging.Handler that outputs logs with rich formatting, including timestamps, log levels, message syntax highlighting, and optional traceback rendering.

methods.name: Text get_level_text(self, record: LogRecord)

methods.description: Handles a log record, formats it, and outputs it to the configured rich console, including traceback rendering if enabled.

methods.description: Converts the log message to a rich Text object, applies highlighting, and markup if enabled.
